dog.description_text:
Hello! My name is Chardonnay and I am the squishiest, cuddliest and most lovable puppy! I'm a little puppy with a big personality and an even bigger heart! I'm still discovering the world, one carrier adventure and one belly rub at a time. I love soaking up attention, playing with toys and finding the coziest spots for a good nap (usually your lap). I'm sweet, curious and always ready to brighten someone's day. I'm looking for a forever family who will shower me with love, patience, cuddles and plenty of adventures. I really really LOVE FOOD. I am highly treat and food motivated and will almost knock anything down to get to my food bowl. I can't wait to meet you!

﻿Chardonnay is approximately 0y 1m 28d old and may be 35 to 45 pounds when fully grown. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
